verdict: SMOKE RUN -- plumbing and liveness check, NOT a result; rerun with ADRN2_SMOKE unset. ADRN-2 SECTION 18 BASELINE LADDER: 5/10 predeclared gates pass over n=2 seeds, where one seed is an independent initialisation AND an independent environment draw, and every MDE is 3*sd/sqrt(n) on the PAIRED per-seed gap. At the primary cadence F=4, ADRN-2A with an INFERRED context (arm 8) reaches a raw held-out RETENTION of 0.5781 inside the feedback-withheld windows that open the two return phases, against 0.6953 for the best of arms 1-5 (2_transformer_frozen_head) -- a paired per-seed gap of -0.1172 against an MDE of 0.0234 -- and against 0.6250 for the same system with context separation switched off (arm 6), a gap of -0.0469 against an MDE of 0.2344. THE SECTION-18 DIAGNOSTIC, reported as a headline rather than a footnote: handing the context over (arm 7) gives 0.9375 against arm 8's 0.5781, a gap of +0.3594 against an MDE of 0.0938, so CONTEXT DETECTION IS THE BOTTLENECK -- the adapters hold what they are told to hold and it is the manager's identification of which context is active that limits retention. That gap has an information-theoretic explanation which is stated here rather than left to be discovered: the environment guarantees by construction that the input distribution is identical in every context and feedback is withheld for the entire window, so inside it there is NO evidence about which context is active and identification is impossible for any non-oracle system of any size. Three references computed on the realised windows frame what is achievable -- the stale-rule floor (keep applying the previous phase's rule) at 0.4453, the two context-blind hedges (over the contexts SEEN SO FAR at 0.6875, over ALL FOUR at 0.7031), and the oracle at 1.0000. Those hedges are REFERENCES, not ceilings, and an earlier version of this file called the smaller of them 'the ceiling for any non-oracle arm' while printing the larger one as reachable by four of those same arms: what the environment bounds is IDENTIFICATION inside the window, not the realised accuracy of an arm holding some other prior, and a window of 64 examples carries a binomial se of 0.0625 in any case. Arm 8's 0.5781 sits at or below the better of the two context-blind hedges (0.7031), so it is best read as HEDGING over stored contexts rather than as RETRIEVING a particular one. G3 is answered per cadence and its answer is mechanistic rather than mysterious: a withheld window can only reveal itself where a CADENCE SLOT falls inside it, so the derived change-detection flag covers 0.97 of the retention window at F=1, 0.88 of the retention window at F=4, 0.50 of the retention window at F=16, 0.00 of the retention window at F=64, and arm 8's retention across those cadences is 0.6250 at F=1, 0.5781 at F=4, 0.5391 at F=16 (UNSUPPORTED: its own mechanisms are starved there), 0.6562 at F=64 (UNSUPPORTED: its own mechanisms are starved there). Cadence and total supervision are the same knob in this specification -- 960 labels at F=1, 240 labels at F=4, 60 labels at F=16, 18 labels at F=64 over an identical stream -- so a retention drop at long cadence cannot be attributed to delay rather than to starvation, and that confound is printed in the table rather than argued away. The four metrics are reported separately and never averaged together: at F=4 arm 8 shows RETENTION 0.5781, RELEARNING 0.6354 once feedback resumes, STEADY 0.8547 late within a phase, and FORGETTING +0.3232 measured as the drop from a context's first-visit steady accuracy to its retention on the return; COST is measured rather than asserted at 1.977 ms and 0.208 updates per example. Every arm was built to a budget of ~30,000 parameters by bisection with realised counts printed, with TWO named exceptions that are exceptions rather than roundings: arm 4 carries 60,000 memory cells (2.0x the budget, because its 625 exemplars are held in each of two stores) and arm 5 carries 98 because a linear model on raw bits has no width to bisect -- the first is a baseline given MORE than the proposal and the second a baseline the specification names, and both are printed in the budget table rather than folded into the word 'matched'; the digital half of every neural arm was pretrained by a byte-identical context-blind recipe and had to pass a per-context linear-probe competence assertion before any online number was taken; every free scalar step size in arms 1-5 was calibrated per seed and per cadence on a SEPARATE validation environment draw over the same grid while the ADRN-2A arms received no calibrated scalar at all; and the change-detection signal derived from the feedback channel was offered to all eight arms in the strongest form each architecture admits -- with how much each arm actually GOT from it measured below rather than assumed -- so no baseline loses for being untuned or for being denied information the proposal was given. Before any number above was allowed into the table, every arm-run had to pass a mechanism liveness assertion proving numerically that its fast adapters changed between updates, that its context posterior was neither collapsed onto one context nor flat uniform, that its consolidated adapter existed and differed from the fast adapter by more than a copy, that its workspace moved across internal steps and did not simply run to the halting cap, that its plasticity controller emitted a varying rate, that its encoder was frozen where it claimed to be frozen and moved where it claimed to fine-tune, and that it performed online updates at all. The change-detection fallback every arm is given is measured by its COUNTERFACTUAL rather than by a counter -- how often taking it changed the prediction -- and where that count is zero the arm is named in `mechanism_ran_but_did_nothing` and no credit for 'every arm got change detection' is claimed for it (at F=4: 1_transformer_full, 4_nn_lookup). Separately, four component flags were toggled on one pretrained model and replayed over the SAME full stream with the prediction trace required to move, and no two differently-configured arms were permitted to return byte-identical per-seed metrics. Most importantly, every arm's adaptive state, encoder and update count were snapshotted at the start of each feedback-withheld window and required to be BYTE-IDENTICAL at its end -- 6 windows per run -- because a label reaching an adapter inside the measurement window would turn every retention number in this file into a relearning number, and until this assertion existed that property rested on an unchecked invariant: a deliberately leaky harness that trained on every withheld step passed every other liveness check in this file and raised retention from 0.6406 to 0.7188.
limits: FALSIFIER, and the most important one: inside a feedback-withheld window the environment guarantees the input distribution is identical across contexts, so no non-oracle arm can identify which context returned. If a future environment leaked ANY context information into x -- different input statistics, a marker channel, a temporal signature -- the retention metric would start measuring inference from inputs rather than retrieval from memory, every non-oracle arm would rise, and the oracle-minus-inferred gap reported here would shrink for reasons that have nothing to do with the context manager.

FALSIFIER: the change-detection signal is derived from the FEEDBACK MASK -- a cadence slot that delivers no label reveals that a probe window has begun. If withholding were randomised so that gaps in feedback carried no information about phase boundaries, every arm's fallback would stop firing and retention should collapse to the stale-rule floor for all of them. That single protocol property is load-bearing for every retention number in this file and it is stated, not hidden.

FALSIFIER: the digital half is pretrained on windows from all four rules, so every rule is linearly decodable before the stream starts. This benchmark therefore tests SELECTION and RETRIEVAL, not representation learning. If the encoder had to discover the rules online, arms 1-3 would be far weaker and the ADRN-2A arms would have nothing linear for their adapters to fix, and neither direction of that change is measured here.

CONFOUND, by design and not correctable within the specification: feedback cadence and total supervision are the same knob. F=64 delivers 64x fewer labels than F=1 over an identical stream, so a retention drop at high F cannot be attributed to delay rather than to starvation. The realised label counts per cadence are printed so the confound is visible in the table.

the retention metric rests on exactly TWO windows per seed (phase 4 on c1, phase 6 on c2), of W=32 examples each, so a single seed's retention carries a binomial standard error near 0.062. The MDE is computed on the PAIRED per-seed gap, which removes the shared stream noise, but no single seed's raw retention should be over-read.

the environment never returns to c4, the one TEMPORAL context, so retention is measured on c1 and c2 only -- both memoryless rules. Nothing here supports a claim about retaining a rule that requires history.

arm 5 (online logistic regression) operates on raw bits and cannot represent XOR, so its ceiling on c1 is 0.5 by construction. That is a property of the baseline the specification names, not a handicap imposed here; arms 2 and 3 are the capacity-matched linear-head controls on a learned representation and they are what makes G1 a real gate. If G1 passed only because arm 5 was weak it would be worthless, which is why the best of arms 1-5 is named in the table.

arm 4 is matched on MEMORY CELLS rather than on trainable parameters, because a lookup arm has no trainable parameters to match. The two budgets are not the same currency and the comparison should be read as capacity-comparable rather than capacity-identical. It also holds TWICE the declared cell budget: the bisection sizes one store and the arm keeps two (a recency FIFO and a reservoir). That was left in place rather than corrected, because shrinking a baseline to fit a budget is the one direction that can manufacture a win for the proposal; the realised multiple is printed in the budget table and named in the verdict.

FALSIFIER for the withheld-window freeze assertion: it proves no arm's state MOVED inside the window. It cannot prove an arm did not stash the window's examples and train on them later, and it would not catch an arm that adapted on the UNLABELLED inputs during the window. The first is impossible here because no label is delivered; the second is a real gap, and an arm with a strong unsupervised objective could exploit it.

the plasticity controller's realised step size varies by well under 1% (cv) about its mean at every cadence measured. It is not a constant -- the liveness assertion would raise -- but 'learned plasticity' is not demonstrated by a network whose output is flat to within a fraction of a percent, and the cv is printed rather than hidden behind a non-zero sd.

the step size of arms 1-5 is calibrated on OVERALL accuracy on the validation draw, while the primary metric here is RETENTION. Those objectives are not the same: a step size that adapts fastest also forgets fastest. The validation schedule contains a return so the two are not orthogonal, but a baseline tuned directly for retention could score higher than the numbers reported here, which makes G1 conservative in the proposal's favour.

ablation arm 6 is allocated a WIDER encoder because it does not pay for a bank of per-context adapters. That biases G2 against arm 8, so a passing G2 is conservative and a failing G2 may partly reflect arm 6's extra capacity.

the ADRN-2A context manager's creation and consolidation thresholds are expressed as a declared function of the labels a phase delivers rather than as raw step counts, because a raw threshold would make the manager unusable at F=64 and trigger-happy at F=1 for reasons unrelated to the mechanism. That scaling is a modelling choice; a different scaling would change how many contexts get allocated, and the realised counts are reported per arm.

compute is matched only in parameters, not in wall-clock. The ADRN-2A arms run up to 3 workspace steps per example and evaluate every context slot's head on every step, so their measured ms/example is structurally higher; the cost table reports the realised numbers rather than asserting efficiency.

eligibility is switched OFF for every ADRN-2A arm and no claim is made about it, because feedback here is SPARSE rather than DELAYED -- the label at a feedback step refers to that step. A genuinely delayed-credit variant of this environment would be needed to test that mechanism.
STAGE 2A ONLY: no dendrites, no episodic memory, no world model, no planner. Nothing in this file supports a claim about those, and nothing in it is evidence about biology data.

VERDICT: SMOKE RUN -- plumbing and liveness check, NOT a result; rerun with ADRN2_SMOKE unset. ADRN-2 SECTION 18 BASELINE LADDER: 5/10 predeclared gates pass over n=2 seeds, where one seed is an independent initialisation AND an independent environment draw, and every MDE is 3*sd/sqrt(n) on the PAIRED per-seed gap. At the primary cadence F=4, ADRN-2A with an INFERRED context (arm 8) reaches a raw held-out RETENTION of 0.5781 inside the feedback-withheld windows that open the two return phases, against 0.6953 for the best of arms 1-5 (2_transformer_frozen_head) -- a paired per-seed gap of -0.1172 against an MDE of 0.0234 -- and against 0.6250 for the same system with context separation switched off (arm 6), a gap of -0.0469 against an MDE of 0.2344. THE SECTION-18 DIAGNOSTIC, reported as a headline rather than a footnote: handing the context over (arm 7) gives 0.9375 against arm 8's 0.5781, a gap of +0.3594 against an MDE of 0.0938, so CONTEXT DETECTION IS THE BOTTLENECK -- the adapters hold what they are told to hold and it is the manager's identification of which context is active that limits retention. That gap has an information-theoretic explanation which is stated here rather than left to be discovered: the environment guarantees by construction that the input distribution is identical in every context and feedback is withheld for the entire window, so inside it there is NO evidence about which context is active and identification is impossible for any non-oracle system of any size. Three references computed on the realised windows frame what is achievable -- the stale-rule floor (keep applying the previous phase's rule) at 0.4453, the two context-blind hedges (over the contexts SEEN SO FAR at 0.6875, over ALL FOUR at 0.7031), and the oracle at 1.0000. Those hedges are REFERENCES, not ceilings, and an earlier version of this file called the smaller of them 'the ceiling for any non-oracle arm' while printing the larger one as reachable by four of those same arms: what the environment bounds is IDENTIFICATION inside the window, not the realised accuracy of an arm holding some other prior, and a window of 64 examples carries a binomial se of 0.0625 in any case. Arm 8's 0.5781 sits at or below the better of the two context-blind hedges (0.7031), so it is best read as HEDGING over stored contexts rather than as RETRIEVING a particular one. G3 is answered per cadence and its answer is mechanistic rather than mysterious: a withheld window can only reveal itself where a CADENCE SLOT falls inside it, so the derived change-detection flag covers 0.97 of the retention window at F=1, 0.88 of the retention window at F=4, 0.50 of the retention window at F=16, 0.00 of the retention window at F=64, and arm 8's retention across those cadences is 0.6250 at F=1, 0.5781 at F=4, 0.5391 at F=16 (UNSUPPORTED: its own mechanisms are starved there), 0.6562 at F=64 (UNSUPPORTED: its own mechanisms are starved there). Cadence and total supervision are the same knob in this specification -- 960 labels at F=1, 240 labels at F=4, 60 labels at F=16, 18 labels at F=64 over an identical stream -- so a retention drop at long cadence cannot be attributed to delay rather than to starvation, and that confound is printed in the table rather than argued away. The four metrics are reported separately and never averaged together: at F=4 arm 8 shows RETENTION 0.5781, RELEARNING 0.6354 once feedback resumes, STEADY 0.8547 late within a phase, and FORGETTING +0.3232 measured as the drop from a context's first-visit steady accuracy to its retention on the return; COST is measured rather than asserted at 1.977 ms and 0.208 updates per example. Every arm was built to a budget of ~30,000 parameters by bisection with realised counts printed, with TWO named exceptions that are exceptions rather than roundings: arm 4 carries 60,000 memory cells (2.0x the budget, because its 625 exemplars are held in each of two stores) and arm 5 carries 98 because a linear model on raw bits has no width to bisect -- the first is a baseline given MORE than the proposal and the second a baseline the specification names, and both are printed in the budget table rather than folded into the word 'matched'; the digital half of every neural arm was pretrained by a byte-identical context-blind recipe and had to pass a per-context linear-probe competence assertion before any online number was taken; every free scalar step size in arms 1-5 was calibrated per seed and per cadence on a SEPARATE validation environment draw over the same grid while the ADRN-2A arms received no calibrated scalar at all; and the change-detection signal derived from the feedback channel was offered to all eight arms in the strongest form each architecture admits -- with how much each arm actually GOT from it measured below rather than assumed -- so no baseline loses for being untuned or for being denied information the proposal was given. Before any number above was allowed into the table, every arm-run had to pass a mechanism liveness assertion proving numerically that its fast adapters changed between updates, that its context posterior was neither collapsed onto one context nor flat uniform, that its consolidated adapter existed and differed from the fast adapter by more than a copy, that its workspace moved across internal steps and did not simply run to the halting cap, that its plasticity controller emitted a varying rate, that its encoder was frozen where it claimed to be frozen and moved where it claimed to fine-tune, and that it performed online updates at all. The change-detection fallback every arm is given is measured by its COUNTERFACTUAL rather than by a counter -- how often taking it changed the prediction -- and where that count is zero the arm is named in `mechanism_ran_but_did_nothing` and no credit for 'every arm got change detection' is claimed for it (at F=4: 1_transformer_full, 4_nn_lookup). Separately, four component flags were toggled on one pretrained model and replayed over the SAME full stream with the prediction trace required to move, and no two differently-configured arms were permitted to return byte-identical per-seed metrics. Most importantly, every arm's adaptive state, encoder and update count were snapshotted at the start of each feedback-withheld window and required to be BYTE-IDENTICAL at its end -- 6 windows per run -- because a label reaching an adapter inside the measurement window would turn every retention number in this file into a relearning number, and until this assertion existed that property rested on an unchecked invariant: a deliberately leaky harness that trained on every withheld step passed every other liveness check in this file and raised retention from 0.6406 to 0.7188.
